text: In November 2022, twenty-three of us said "speaker nancy pelosi," peaking on the seventeenth; that same day eighteen of us said "the first woman" and seventeen said "speaker of the house." Henry Cuellar had first said "speaker nancy pelosi" back on 2019-01-03; Amy Klobuchar had first said "the first woman" on 2013-01-03. On the seventeenth seventeen of us said "affordable care act" and sixteen said "the affordable care act," both traced to Christopher Murphy on 2015-01-05. By the thirtieth we had moved together to "paid sick leave," which eighteen of us said; fifteen said "days of paid" and fourteen said "days of paid sick leave," each first said by Rosa L. DeLauro on 2017-03-15. "Paid sick leave" itself was first said by Bernard Sanders on 2015-01-03. We converged on two days, the seventeenth and the thirtieth.
